stemAssignment.source: No CP02 assignment exists for CIN_014; ben_mua music + wind_canopy ambience are the seal-and-gate cues (composed, CP26/CP30) for this scene (S01: Tong Banh kneeling among discarded armour pieces and a torn banner before a ruined stone wall with bamboo and mountains behind, MEDIUM_STATIC; S02: Tong Banh in close detail, conical hat on his back, setting the seal down on a square seal plate on the stone ground, DETAIL_LOCKED; S03: Tong Banh in a blue robe standing at the open wooden village gate facing the gathered villagers, bamboo and thatched roofs around, WIDE_STATIC; keyframes CIN_014 S01/S02/S03). ben_mua is the campaign's own leitmotif statement ('Ben Mua', the rain quay): D major pentatonic question phrase hanging on scale degree 2, tail withheld -- the unresolved hanging phrase for a commander who stamps an order he knows is false ('Ta biet lenh ay la gia. Ta van cho dong dau.'). Its only previous scene-mix use was CIN_003, ten scenes ago. wind_canopy is the wind bed through the bamboo canopy with leaf rustle for the bamboo that frames all three shots. lam_trieu was passed over: the pastoral flute was just used for CIN_013, the immediately preceding scene. tran_son ('Tran Son — Nguoi qua cua', the bell-led gate form) was passed over: it is the gate cue by name, but it was already used for CIN_008 and CIN_012 -- a third gate-cue use in four scenes would blur the scenes. sa_hoa is desert/dry (wrong setting); quiet_discovery was just used for CIN_011; bach_uyen is the underwater low-passed form (wrong setting); rift_finale is the set's only full close (finale material, wrong for a mid-campaign decision beat); boss_mang_cot is boss material. The reveal stinger is the scene's only manifest-listed candidate stem (CIN_014_timing_v1.json).

Staging: the timing manifest marks the S03 dialogue onscreen: true for Tong Banh, and the S03 keyframe places a blue-robed figure at the open village gate facing the gathered villagers -- the intended speaker position. But the recorded keyframe defects (scene export manifest) note Tong Banh is not visually identifiable in S03: his armour differs across S01/S02 and neither S03 figure matches it. That ambiguity is a final-picture/character-lock matter, not a mix defect; the mix does not move the VO.

Ducking depth is measured on the ducked bus against its unducked render (RMS over the full VO window vs a 2 s reference before the window). The full-window method from checkpoint 39 is retained so the depth is comparable across the CIN_003/CIN_005/CIN_007/CIN_008/ CIN_009/CIN_010/CIN_011/CIN_012/CIN_013/CIN_014 mixes (a 2 s slice can understate the cut on cues whose window opening is quiet).
Ambience loop join uses a 1 s acrossfade; loopQA reports the max sample jump at the join against the bed's own 99.9th-percentile jump.
Stinger placement at 6.0 s (S02 start) is PROPOSED pending picture lock, mirroring the CIN_004 reveal at 6.0 s.
